label: Slots indexed by time modulo the wheel size
section: Slots indexed by time modulo the wheel size
subgoals: Compute the due time as current time plus delay
Map the due time to slot due time mod N
Append the event to that slot's list in constant time

label: The overflow list for far-future events
section: The overflow list for far-future events
subgoals: Identify the window of times the wheel covers
Send events at or beyond base plus N to the overflow list
Migrate overflow events into the wheel as the base advances

label: Advancing time in jumps
subgoals: List the distinct timestamps in the queue
Process all events of one time before advancing
Skip empty times by jumping to the next occupied slot
